title: mespilus tanacetifolia var. heldreichii
intro: Mespilus tanacetifolia var. heldreichii, commonly known as the Greek hawthorn or white hawthorn, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Greek medicine, where it is believed to have various health benefits such as lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Mespilus tanacetifolia var. heldreichii include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
